data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No standalone endpoint exists to fetch a ticket by id outside the workspace payload.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Use GET /tickets/{ticketId}/workspace wherever ticket-level detail is needed.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No API endpoint exists to actually trigger backend execution beyond creating/updating run records.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Any UI action labeled 'start verification' or 'start triage run' must be framed as creating the run record for POV simulation/tracking, not guaranteeing orchestration of an execution engine.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to query events by ticket_id directly.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Event review must always be scoped to a specific run id.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No endpoint exists to get a guidance suggestion by id.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Guidance edit interactions should originate from lists returned by workspace or run-scoped guidance endpoints.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: No server-sent events/websocket endpoint exists despite streaming use case.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: All real-time monitoring should rely on periodic polling and visible refresh status.

data_constraints_and_gaps.gap: Timeout watch threshold customization is not truly supported in this POV.
data_constraints_and_gaps.frontend_implication: Do not expose arbitrary threshold controls; use default backend behavior only.
